title: Linux Storage: Filesystems, Mounts & Safe Maintenance
purpose: Eight connected exercises on bounded regular-file disk images. Sequence is recommended, never locked.
prerequisites: Bash quoting/functions/statuses, permissions, backups and deliberate guest-only sudo. Use the unchanged approved administrator image.
coverage: LPIC-1 v5.0 104.1/104.2/104.3 and LPIC-2 v4.5 203.1/203.2 partial. Introductory102.1 preparation and104.5 reinforcement only. No complete objective, AutoFS or boot-mount claim.

objectives: 102.1 introductory layout preparation; 104.3 / 203.1 partial device and mount inspection
